title: Find the role. Own the next step.
subtitle: One workspace for your search, your evidence and your applications.
narration: Meet ApplyPilot. Find the role, prepare your evidence, and own the next step.

title: A workspace built around your next move.
subtitle: Use the sidebar to move between opportunities, documents and progress.
narration: This is the new application workspace. Your opportunities stay in view, with clear navigation, a collapsible sidebar, and a choice of light or dark theme.

title: Start with the facts.
subtitle: Settings → professional profile → review and save your application details.
narration: Start in Settings. Keep your contact information, work authorization, availability, summary, and skills current. Save the facts you want reused on applications. Professional evidence gives document preparation and form assistance a reliable starting point.

title: Every version. Every qualification.
subtitle: CV Studio → source library → qualifications → versioned document preview.
narration: CV Studio brings your source resumes and role variants together. Import a CV, edit the source text, and maintain qualifications and experience. Then choose an opportunity to inspect its saved CV. Version history and previews help you review the exact document before downloading it.

title: Show the work behind the skills.
subtitle: Portfolio → verified achievements, technologies, links and reusable evidence.
narration: Build a portfolio from work you can explain. Keep project achievements, dates, technologies, and links together. Included projects become reusable evidence for future application documents.

title: Make the search focused.
subtitle: Pipeline → roles and locations → CV routing → sources → preview the work.
narration: In Pipeline, shape a focused search. Choose your roles, priorities, and resume mappings. Add country, region, city, or remote locations, and inspect discovery coverage. Select relevant sources, including direct employer sites. Preview the effective search scope and budgets before you run the workflow. Discovery, assessment, and document preparation remain separate stages.

title: Decide where to spend your attention.
subtitle: Jobs → search → open the record → review the evidence → Pick.
narration: Search your opportunities and open a job record. Compare the role with the saved fit assessment and professional evidence. Inspect its requirements, document state, and timeline. Pick the opportunities you want to prepare, and keep the rest organized with archive and block controls.

title: Turn criteria into reviewed documents.
subtitle: Cover Studio + Statement Studio → target → draft → validate → preview.
narration: Cover Studio and Statement Studio keep the target role beside your working draft. Review the actual criteria, select relevant evidence, and check word or character limits. Edit your own text, validate it, and save another version. Preview the document and download it when you are ready. Publication is an explicit action.

title: Prepare the packet. Inspect the work.
subtitle: Pipeline → Prepare selected applications → preview queues and recovery.
narration: Return to Pipeline to prepare selected applications. Preview the required CV, supporting statement, cover letter, and PDF work. Stage counts show what still needs attention. Recent runs and scoped recovery controls keep preparation visible.

title: Apply with visibility and control.
subtitle: Review the packet → open the shared browser → take over → final review.
narration: Open Apply with agent from the job record. Review your application packet first. The shared browser lets you watch the employer page and take over when needed. Click and type directly in the live view, or select an answer field. Final submission has a separate review and approval checkpoint. This example uses a controlled demonstration employer form.

title: Keep the next conversation in context.
subtitle: Applications → hiring status → notes → reminder → calendar export.
narration: Applications separates submission from the hiring outcome. Open a record, add a hiring update, and keep recruiter details and notes together. Set a reminder, export it to your calendar, and use the timeline to understand what happened.

title: Turn messages into next steps.
subtitle: Evidence inbox → import → inspect the source → review the hiring update.
narration: Bring employer evidence into the inbox. Import a message or connect a supported mailbox. Review its category, matching opportunity, and original text before recording a hiring update. The source message stays available for context.

title: See the story behind your progress.
subtitle: Insights → interactive charts → drill down → export the underlying records.
narration: Insights explains your saved activity. Explore opportunity cohorts, preparation milestones, sources, fit scores, and recorded hiring progress. Click chart segments to narrow the view. The opportunity ledger preserves the context of each event, including retained history. Export the records and activity for your own analysis. These figures come from demonstration data.

title: Clear the clutter. Keep the story.
subtitle: History & storage → closure reasons → retained timeline → storage controls.
narration: History and storage keeps the story after an opportunity closes. Inspect the reason and retained timeline, review generated-file storage, and manage cleanup without losing the historical context.

title: Make the workspace yours.
subtitle: Settings → private AI connections → task routing → portable backup.
narration: Configure private AI connections and task preferences in Settings. Inspect usage budgets, optional observer tools, and download a portable workspace backup. Administrators also retain account and audit controls.
